executedCoverage: All eight original P7 criteria consume seven existing attempt2 execution records with archived file SHA256 and recordSHA256 matching the execution manifest.
Deep-frozen exact records and capabilities remain byte-equivalent after all model builds; renderer preparation does not mutate models.
Exact dyadic endpoints, nonzero widths, tolerance flags and source field paths survive display collapse and compacted-record extraction.
Null, undefined, booleans, nonfinite values and blank strings are not coerced into plotted zeros; actual numeric zero remains representable.
Balancing 4096-bit dyadic inputs and representable subnormal rational values yield finite display coordinates.
Infinity point O stays explicit in the arithmetic table and interrupts affine guide lines; unknown rank upper bounds remain null.
Finite positive-zero count 3 is distinguished from count 6 in the symmetric +/-T contour; no global RH promotion occurs.
Independent prime values and the original coarse theoretical psi band remain separate; conjugate-pair contributions are not doubled again.
Operator negative controls and seven OPEN RH bridges, and L/Lambda derivative and exact-parity distinctions, remain visible.
Invalid/promoted envelopes and non-completed runs produce no geometry; archive examples explicitly retain non-live/unverified provenance.
Stage 8 supplied log1p heights, clipped values and pole holes remain numerical indicators with no zero certificate.

findings.problem: The rational display converter originally evaluated 2**power before multiplication, losing a representable subnormal value when power was below -1074.
findings.fix: Shared split-exponent scaleBinary conversion; no numerical certification code changed.
